name: Design tokens, component library, and application shell
summary: The literal design system inside the product system. Capabilities never ship their own styles; they register surfaces into the shell and consume tokens. Branding a client is a token change and nothing else, which is what keeps a client's look out of the merge path entirely.

owns.name: DesignToken
owns.description: The token set. Manifest branding overrides values here and nowhere else.

exposes.name: primitives
exposes.signature: Button, Input, Select, Table, Dialog, Sheet, Card, Toast, Form, DataGrid
exposes.description: The component library every capability composes from.

exposes.name: navigation
exposes.description: Navigation entries contributed by capabilities, ordered by the navigationOrder slot.

exposes.name: dashboardWidgets
exposes.description: Widgets contributed to the default dashboard.
